title: Inline alert banners for info, success, warning and error
when: The user wants message boxes inside the page: info notes, success confirmations, warnings and errors.
prompt:
Goal: Alert styles that differ without color, announce only when inserted dynamically and dismiss cleanly.
Steps:
1. Each alert: an aria-hidden icon, a bold title word (Info, Done, Warning, Error) and one or two sentences saying what to do next.
2. Static alerts need no role; script inserted alerts go into an existing container with role="status", or role="alert" for urgent errors.
3. Tinted background, dark text at 4.5 to 1, and a 4 px border on the inline start side per variant.
4. <button type="button" aria-label="Dismiss message"> removes the alert and moves focus to the next logical element.
5. A form error summary lists each problem as a link to its field id.
Quality bar:
- Icon and title word tell variants apart in grayscale.
- Error text says how to fix it.
- Alerts align with the content column.
Pitfalls:
- role="alert" on static text, which interrupts every page load.
- Red versus green as the only difference.
- Something went wrong with no next step.
Verify:
- [ ] Four variants with distinct icons and words.
- [ ] Dynamic messages land in an existing live container.
- [ ] Dismiss buttons have a name.
- [ ] Contrast reaches 4.5 to 1.
Output: Alert markup patterns, alert.css with the variants, a small alert.js for dismiss.

examples.input: caixas de aviso de erro, sucesso e atencao
examples.output: four alert variants with icon and title word, left border, dismiss button, error summary linking to fields
